title: Resource Groups Config Schema
description: Phase 1 configuration: the Azure resource groups to create first, ahead of any security group, environment, identity, or GitHub environment resources.

resourceGroups.description: Azure resource groups to create. Each represents a stage in the deployment (e.g. dev, stg, prd).

id.description: Local id used to reference this resource group from 'environments.jsonc' and 'security-groups.jsonc' role assignments. Not an Azure identifier.

location.description: Azure location name for the resource group.

tags.description: Tags to apply to the resource group.
